verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms monday.com serves an llms.txt file (HTTP 200) at developer.monday.com/llms.txt, headed as the Platform API documentation, so an agent can be pointed straight at it. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a well-known path and a developer MCP that connects to any agent add further agent-oriented entry points. missing for 10: verified depth and coverage of the llms.txt content beyond its header, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Connect the developer MCP to any agent.
